core_obligations: First, by groupoids-lemma-group-scheme-over-field-separated the stabilizer group scheme G to U is separated. Second, by groupoids-lemma-diagonal the morphism j = (t, s) : R to U x_S U is separated. Third, since U is the spectrum of a field, U x_S U is affine by the construction of fibre products in the fibre products section of Schemes. Finally, schemes-lemma-separated-permanence applied to the separated morphism j with affine target U x_S U gives that R is a separated scheme.
proof_roadmap: Get separatedness of the stabilizer G to U from the group scheme over a field lemma (proof lines 1177-1179).
Get separatedness of j = (t, s) : R to U x_S U from the diagonal lemma (proof lines 1179-1181).
Note U x_S U is affine over the field and apply separated permanence to conclude R is separated (proof lines 1182-1186).
